title: /random backport
description: a very simple mod that ports the /random command to an older version
body:
a backwards port of the `/random` command added in 1.20.2
compatible with `/execute store` and anything else that needs a command return, `/random roll` can be used by any players and does not return anything, it just sends a random number in the chosen range in chat, `/random value` can only be used  by operators and does return the random value it generates, but does not send anything in chat
